verdicts.reason: Both leave an unexplained white strip above the blue header, which looks like a mistake, and the legal line is tiny. A otherwise keeps one clean left edge (~32px) for the logo, headline, fare list, CTA and legal text, with matching right margins on the prices. B breaks that grid: the city/price list sits about 14px from the canvas edges while the headline is at ~32px and the CTA and legal text are at ~22px, so nothing aligns and the list feels jammed against the sides.
